lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, organized in roughly parallel horizontal and vertical rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to create a structured grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance above to shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense concentration of small, high-luminance spots localized on the distal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
